lifecycleScripts.afterStart: wp-env run --config=.wp-env.test.json wordpress bash -c 'command -v mysql >/dev/null || (sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq mariadb-client >/dev/null); command -v wp >/dev/null || (sudo curl -sSfL -o /usr/local/bin/wp https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wp-cli/builds/gh-pages/phar/wp-cli.phar && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/wp); git config --global user.name "VersionPress Tests"; git config --global user.email tests@example.com'
